Caveats

  • cost_usd is Claude Code's own estimate at API list prices, not an invoice. On a Pro/Max subscription it stands for rate-limit headroom you use up, not money.
  • Periods differ in workload. Compare per-active-hour numbers and the agent_summary share, and collect a few days per period. The summary only runs while background agents/subagents run.
  • Fail-open: a Claude Code update can rename what the hook looks for. Then summaries silently come back. Check the CC versions column, the hook evidence table and run -Status / -Replicate after updates.
  • Processes that started before a change keep the old setting; periods start only when none was left (or when you confirmed). The Claude desktop app's Code tab runs its own bundled Claude Code (in %APPDATA%\Claude\claude-code), which inherits BUN_OPTIONS from the app; the app must be fully quit and reopened after a change. Cowork mode runs in its own VM and is probably not covered.
  • The logger stores only: time, event type, session id, model, query_source, token counts, cost estimate, duration, Claude Code version and agent type. No prompts, responses, e-mail or account ids. Only what reaches 127.0.0.1 on this PC.
  • Unofficial tool; changing client behaviour may conflict with the service terms. Hook (c) Flamerix AI, MIT.
